# P04 generated configuration fixtures

The [IsOS configuration contract](../../../docs/isos/interfaces/configuration.md#p04-generated-configuration-and-launch-preflight-target) owns this schema. `cases.json` freezes the exact case IDs, operations, mutations, diagnostic codes, stages and JSON Pointer paths for P04 implementation tests. `active_unchanged_on_failure` also requires unchanged saved graph bytes, saved revision, active revision, selected generation and child PIDs. P01's `package_changed` case deliberately remains a P01 diagnostic rather than being remapped to a `generated_*` code.

Use a fresh `ISOS_HOME`, an EOS setup stub or built `aether-profile`, and an EGIA schema-1 setup stub that returns the three managed overlays. Seed private installed EGIA component and factory default trees; the component tree contains the eight listed effective files and an extra nested regular file. Select both through the configured EGIA distribution and avoid writing either repository checkout. The stub reports an EOS gRPC gateway endpoint only for rendering; runtime EGIA stays disabled until R02. Hash exact graph bytes, then record the selected generation and manifest. Repeat Apply to prove byte-for-byte idempotence. Change one selected binary or default file and Apply the same saved revision to prove a distinct immutable generation. Run/Restart negative cases begin from a running EOS-only deployment so they can prove no stop or replacement on failure.

The missing-file cases cover EGIA's direct loaders (`prompts.toml`, `missions.toml`), the safety gate and adapter-generated `profiles/isos.toml`. A symlinked installed default, escaping overlay path, owner rejection, changed package receipt, generated-file tamper, paired file/manifest tamper, stale selection and absent child-only secret each fail before spawn or active replacement with the frozen diagnostic. The legacy case confirms a safe `1.0.0` graph keeps its flat snapshot and original bytes. Assert complete `0700` directory and `0600` file permissions, no unlisted files, sorted manifest entries, stable generation hash, no secret value in graph/manifest/logs, and sanitized CLI/API errors. The actual reader feature-set negotiation and upgrade suggestions are P05 fixtures.
